# Free LLM Models

> Free LLM Models is a searchable directory of currently free AI models across OpenRouter, Groq, Google AI Studio, Cerebras, Mistral, Hugging Face, and NVIDIA NIM.

The catalog is refreshed from provider APIs. Availability, limits, model policies, and pricing can change; verify important details with the provider before production use.

## Catalog

- [Free AI model directory](https://free-llm-models.vercel.app/): Search and filter the current free model catalog by provider, modality, context length, reasoning, tools, and other capabilities.
- [Free models JSON](https://free-llm-models.vercel.app/free_models.json): Machine-readable aggregate catalog with model metadata and provider identifiers.
- [Per-provider model index](https://free-llm-models.vercel.app/models/index.json): Provider files and model counts used by the website.

## Pages

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://free-llm-models.vercel.app/faq): API keys, first API calls, rate limits, integrations, and API key security.
- [Former free models](https://free-llm-models.vercel.app/archive): Models that have left the current free catalog.
- [Model details](https://free-llm-models.vercel.app/): Individual model pages use the URL pattern `/model/{encoded-model-id}`.

## Optional

- [OpenRouter documentation](https://openrouter.ai/docs): Provider API documentation and integration guides.
- [Project source](https://github.com/luongnv89/free-llm-models): Updater and web application source code.
